chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Verily, Allah, the Exalted, did not prescribe for women any makeup (of missed fasts) nor any fasting other than the fasting of Ramadan, unless it is a vow, or expiation fasting, or voluntary fasting.
ai.seo_question: Do women need to make up missed Ramadan fasts after menstruation?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the juristic consensus that menstruating and postpartum women are exempt from making up (*qada*) missed Ramadan fasts, distinguishing this from the obligation to make up missed prayers. This ruling underscores the Shia view that menstruation is a natural state of ritual impurity rather than a defect requiring compensation for the fast itself, except when tied to specific vows or expiations. The narration reinforces the principle that the obligation of fasting is suspended during these periods without the burden of retroactive fulfillment.
